channels_done_auto_archive_idx.name: channels_done_auto_archive_idx
channels_done_auto_archive_idx.where: "channels"."parent_id" is not null and "channels"."status" = 'done' and "channels"."archived_at" is null

channels_workspace_ticket_key_unq.name: channels_workspace_ticket_key_unq
channels_workspace_ticket_key_unq.where: "channels"."parent_id" is null and "channels"."ticket_key" is not null

notifications_reaction_unq.name: notifications_reaction_unq
notifications_reaction_unq.where: "notifications"."type" = 'reaction' and "notifications"."message_id" is not null and "notifications"."emoji" is not null
